title: Royal Rajasthan Heritage Expedition (Jaipur, Jodhpur & Udaipur)
hotel_name: Fort Rajwada & Shiv Niwas Palace View Resort
description: Experience royal grandiosity across Rajasthan's legendary fortresses and romantic lakes. Stay in heritage palaces in Jaipur, marvel at Mehrangarh Fort in Jodhpur, and enjoy a private boat ride on Lake Pichola in Udaipur.
highlights: Royal Elephant Ride & Amber Fort Sound & Light Show in Jaipur
Private Sunset Boat Cruise on Lake Pichola in Udaipur
Mehrangarh Fort & Umaid Bhawan Palace Exploration in Jodhpur
Authentic Chokhi Dhani Rajasthani Folk Village Cultural Evening
Heritage Haveli Stay with Royal Rajasthani Buffet Dinners

included_services.meals: Daily Buffet Breakfast & Royal Rajasthani Thali Dinners
included_services.transport: Private Chauffeur Driven AC Innova Crysta
included_services.guide: Government Approved Historian Guide at Forts
included_services.activities: Lake Pichola Boat Cruise & Chokhi Dhani Entry Included

excluded_services: Camera & Video Shooting Permits at Palaces

itinerary.title: Jaipur Pink City Arrival & Chokhi Dhani
itinerary.description: Pickup from Jaipur Airport/Railway Station. Check-in to Heritage Haveli Hotel. Afternoon visit to City Palace and Hawa Mahal. Evening excursion to Chokhi Dhani for Rajasthani folk dance and traditional dinner.

itinerary.title: Amer Fort & Jaipur Heritage Marvels
itinerary.description: Morning elephant/jeep ride up to Amber Fort. Explore Sheesh Mahal (Mirror Palace), Jaigarh Fort (world's largest cannon on wheels), and Jal Mahal sunset view.

itinerary.title: Jaipur to Jodhpur Blue City Transit
itinerary.description: Scenic drive to Jodhpur. Visit Mehrangarh Fort perched on a cliff, Jaswant Thada marble cenotaph, and colorful Clock Tower spice markets.

itinerary.title: Jodhpur to Udaipur City of Lakes Drive
itinerary.description: En-route visit to 15th-century marble Ranakpur Jain Temple. Arrive in Udaipur, check-in to Lake View Palace Hotel.

itinerary.title: Udaipur City Palace & Lake Pichola Boat Ride
itinerary.description: Explore City Palace complex, Saheliyon-Ki-Bari fountains garden, and Jagdish Temple. Evening private sunset boat cruise on Lake Pichola overlooking Jag Mandir Palace.

itinerary.title: Udaipur Handicraft Shopping & Departure
itinerary.description: Buy miniature paintings, leather craft, and silver jewelry. Private transfer to Udaipur Maharana Pratap Airport for departure.

cancellation_policy: Full refund up to 10 days before departure. 50% refund between 4 to 9 days.
travel_tips: Wear comfortable walking shoes for cobblestone fort ramps
Bargain politely at local leather and handicraft markets

faqs.question: Is the boat ride in Udaipur private?
faqs.answer: Yes, our luxury package includes private boat transfers on Lake Pichola.
